purpose: Expected schema for the Online Retail II dataset: what 'correct' looks like before cleaning. Every column declares its expected type, value ranges, formats and acceptance targets. Cleaning steps validate against this contract.

dataset.grain: one row per invoice line item (an InvoiceNo may span many rows)
dataset.primary_key_note: No single column is unique: the most granular column (InvoiceNo) has 4976 distinct values over 100000 rows, so the grain is the line item, not the invoice.

key_candidates.note: Candidate composite key for the line-item grain; cleaning must assert uniqueness, not assume it.

row_validity_rules.rule: UnitPrice == 0  =>  adjustment/giveaway line, not a sale
row_validity_rules.handling: keep flagged (IsGiveaway); exclude from revenue metrics
keep with sign (IsReturn); never take abs()

row_validity_rules.rule: InvoiceNo LIKE 'C%'  =>  cancellation of a prior invoice
row_validity_rules.handling: retain as negative-value events (IsCancellation); net revenue requires pairing with the original
keep for revenue analytics; exclude only from customer-level segmentation

row_validity_rules.rule: Description IS NULL  =>  product name not captured

derived_columns.note: Signed line value: negative for returns, zero for giveaways.

value_families.name: prefixed_code
value_families.note: A leading 'C' marks a credit/cancellation event, not a distinct entity - valid values, never dropped silently.

variants.name: prefixed_code
variants.note: A leading 'C' marks a credit/cancellation event, not a distinct entity - valid values, never dropped silently.

constraints.message: InvoiceNo must stay text: its text codes would be destroyed by numeric casting.
Every non-null InvoiceNo must match one known value family.
InvoiceNo must be upper-case after cleaning.

value_families.name: prefixed_code
value_families.note: A leading 'C' marks a credit/cancellation event, not a distinct entity - valid values, never dropped silently.

value_families.name: service_or_adjustment_code
value_families.matching: case-insensitive at match time; values canonicalise to upper() afterwards
value_families.note: Non-merchandise codes (carriage, samples, manual adjustments, test rows). The operative pattern accepts a lowercase lead letter because this column carries case-variant spellings of the same codes; values still canonicalise to upper(). Valid rows; keep, do not drop.

variants.name: prefixed_code
variants.note: A leading 'C' marks a credit/cancellation event, not a distinct entity - valid values, never dropped silently.

variants.name: service_or_adjustment_code
variants.matching: case-insensitive at match time; values canonicalise to upper() afterwards
variants.note: Non-merchandise codes (carriage, samples, manual adjustments, test rows). The operative pattern accepts a lowercase lead letter because this column carries case-variant spellings of the same codes; values still canonicalise to upper(). Valid rows; keep, do not drop.

constraints.message: StockCode must stay text: its text codes would be destroyed by numeric casting.
Every non-null StockCode must match one known value family.
StockCode must be upper-case after cleaning.
StockCode must carry no leading/trailing whitespace.

Description.null_semantics: Missing means the product name was not captured; impute from StockCode, never invent text.

null_policy.action: impute from the StockCode->Description lookup; only if the StockCode itself is unknown may the row be dropped

constraints.message: Description is free-text product naming.
Descriptions carry no leading/trailing whitespace (18,717 padded values observed).
Internal whitespace collapses to single spaces.
Descriptions canonicalise to upper case (case-variant groups observed).
Empty strings are not valid descriptions.
Descriptions are short product names, not prose.

constraints.rule: Description IS NULL only before imputation
constraints.message: 0.41% of rows lack a description; every gap is imputable from its StockCode, so zero residual nulls are expected after cleaning.
After case/whitespace normalisation each StockCode maps to exactly one Description.

tiers.note: Inside the hard bounds but outside the plausible band.

tiers.action: reject row as a data error

constraints.message: Quantity must be int-typed after cleaning.
Quantity outside [-10000, 10000] is a data error.
Quantities are whole units; fractional quantities are data errors.
A zero-unit line item is physically meaningless.
2263 (2.26%) negative rows are returns/cancellations - keep with sign, never take abs().
Bulk quantities are plausible wholesale orders but must be reviewed, not auto-dropped.

Quantity.notes: Sign is signal: negative = return/credit. The 11.05% of rows outside the IQR fences are ordinary retail spread, not dirt - cleaning must not winsorise them away.

value_range.rule: 2009-01-01 00:00:00 <= InvoiceDate <= 2011-12-31 23:59:59 (calendar-year envelope of the observed range)

constraints.message: InvoiceDate renders as '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S': 4-digit year, 2-digit month/day/hour/minute/second, space-separated.

constraints.rule: InvoiceDate has second resolution, no sub-second part
constraints.message: Finer timestamps than one second are data errors.
No timezone offsets or zone names may appear.
InvoiceDate must fall inside the 2009-2011 business window (observed min/max floored/ceiled to whole calendar years).
A transaction timestamp in the future is a data error.
InvoiceDate is never missing in the profiled data.

tiers.note: Inside the hard bounds but outside the plausible band.

tiers.action: reject row as a data error

constraints.message: UnitPrice must be float-typed after cleaning.
UnitPrice outside [0.0, 20000.0] is a data error.
A negative price is impossible - data error.
595 zero-price rows are adjustments/giveaways, not real prices: keep flagged, exclude from revenue metrics.

constraints.rule: UnitPrice has at most 2 decimal places
constraints.message: Prices are currency values with at most 2 decimals.
Large-ticket prices are plausible but must be verified against the source system.

UnitPrice.notes: Zero prices are legitimate adjustment lines; negatives are not. Only 13 rows exceed 1000.0.

CustomerID.null_semantics: Missing denotes guest checkout / unattributed orders - a valid state that must be preserved. Never fill with 0 or -1.

constraints.message: CustomerID must stay text: its text codes would be destroyed by numeric casting.
Every non-null CustomerID must match one known value family.
CustomerID is a whole-number identifier; fractional values are data errors.
CustomerID must fall inside the anonymised ID block.
CustomerID only joins and groups; it is never a model feature raw.
CustomerID directly singles out an individual.

value_range.rule: 12000 <= CustomerID <= 19000 (observed range [12346, 18287] rounded outward to the nearest 1000)
value_range.id_block_note: IDs are non-contiguous; never assume sequence or density.

allowed_values.alias_rule: strip, title-case, then apply the alias map
allowed_values.on_unknown_value: flag for review; never silently drop

constraints.message: Country is a geographic label.
Country names carry no leading/trailing whitespace.

constraints.rule: Country is title case ('United Kingdom', not 'UNITED KINGDOM')
constraints.message: Country canonicalises to title case.
Country names are letters plus space/dot/apostrophe/hyphen.

constraints.rule: legacy spellings map to canonical names (EIRE->Ireland, USA->United States, plus the remaining alias map entries)
constraints.message: Alias spellings denote real countries; normalise, do not drop.
Country stays low-cardinality (observed 28; new distinct values beyond the reference set are flagged).
Country is never missing in the profiled data.

constraints.rule: Country is a quasi-identifier: safe for grouping, watch k-anonymity in small cells
constraints.message: Geography only identifies in combination.

cleaning_plan.evidence: 18717 padded Description values; StockCode case-variant groups whose members differ by padding ('85036B' vs '85036b' families aside).
90 StockCode + 31 Description value groups differing only by case.
Legacy spellings in this dataset family ('EIRE', 'USA') denote 'Ireland' / 'United States'.
InvoiceDate must parse as '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S', second resolution, tz-naive.
CustomerID reads as float64 ('12346.0') because of NaNs; expected storage is nullable Int64.
408 Description gaps (0.41%) are imputable from the StockCode->Description lookup; all other rows map 1:1 after case/whitespace normalisation.
Revenue, cancellation and return analytics require signed line values and line-type flags.
